notes: Audio effects such as Normalize and Echo now keep your sound at its original sample rate and length, so a clip no longer ends on a frozen frame. “Export selected clips” now appears in the panel you see when clips are selected, and it exports just those clips. Switching a montage to music-synced now shows straight away that the song sets its length. A photo your camera stored sideways is now enlarged at the size it shows on screen, and a grid of portrait phone videos now comes out portrait instead of cropping each one into a landscape cell. Typing “don’t denoise too much”, “go easy on the brightness” or “brighten it, but not too much” now makes a gentle change, instead of turning the request down or running it at full strength. “Restore my wedding highlights” now restores your highlights video instead of darkening its bright parts, and “keep the sound” gets a straight answer. Time estimates for rotated phone clips and widescreen tapes are now worked out at the size Crisp actually writes.
